watch.text: Starting PG Landen Joseph (ankle, hurt 11/20 vs Utah) sat vs Northwestern on 11/22 and Dayton lost 79-55; ratings built with him overstate Dayton while he is out.
Northwestern lost Ryan Soulis for the season (foot, 11/13) and Luke McEldon is out; thin frontcourt in losses to DePaul and Columbia (75-53) that early ratings didn't see.
Starter Neo Avdalas (9.0 ppg, team-high 3.8 apg) broke his left wrist late in the 78-70 loss to Georgia; out about two months, so ratings built with him overstate UNC now.
7-foot C Cameron Fens missed the first four games over NCAA eligibility and is now playing under a temporary restraining order (through a hearing or Dec 1).
Jalen Haralson (20.5 mpg, right knee) has missed two straight games (Coastal Carolina 11/21, Maryland 11/24); the team does not think it is long-term. Status for Iowa State not given.
Guard Jordan Marsh (18-30 mpg, 16 pts in the opener) missed the 11/22 SFA game with an upper-body injury; day to day, status for UT Martin unconfirmed.
Seth Trimble (28 mpg) missed the Stetson win on 11/20 and returned for 32 minutes in the 72-64 win over Texas Tech on 11/24.
Reserve guard Isaac Ellis (13.5 mpg, ankle) is out for the whole Players Era Festival week.
Dominic Pangonis and Noah Lewis are out for the ESPN Events Invitational, per the school; neither played Nov 23 (66-64 win over Akron) or Nov 24 (72-70 OT loss to St. Bonaventure).
Starting F Duke Brennan broke his ankle in practice on 11/16 and is out for an extended period; he started 4 of Oklahoma's 5 games, so our ratings are mostly built with him.

Solo Ball (offseason wrist surgery) has not played this season; Dan Hurley says he is nearing game-time-decision status for the 11/25 Duke game. If he plays, ratings built without him understate UConn.
PG Javon Bennett (16.5 mpg, started vs Montana State) has a right knee sprain and is out for the Players Era 16 and likely into December; our ratings carry his games.
Guard Jack Janicki (17.8 mpg) is out for the season after foot surgery; Wisconsin has 12 available players, with Manchester and Fenderson also out.
Forward Malik Reneau, first-team All-ACC last season, missed the Rider and Manhattan games and returned for 29 minutes vs TCU on 11/24; our ratings carry the games without him.

401909495.summary: The gap comes from our own AlphaPoint models (Michigan by 10.1, v2 15.6); Haslametrics (4.8) sits with the market, which has moved from Michigan -4.5 at open to -5.5. No injury news found for either team before tip.

reasons.text: Neutral-site Players Era game in Las Vegas on 11/24; Creighton's opening game of the event. The line has moved from 4.5 at open to Michigan -5.5 (DraftKings).
Same-day preview: Michigan (3-2, out of the AP poll after a loss to Villanova) vs Creighton (4-1), with no injury or lineup news for either team; Michigan is now coached by Mike Boynton Jr.

swings.Kansas State: Nothing found: no injury news for either team in the Players Era previews; the line moved from Gonzaga -12.5 (opened 11/22) to -15.5 by tip without a clear reason.

swings.Oregon: Nothing found: no injury news on either side (Rick Pitino said Theo Edema, toe, will play), but the market has moved toward St. John's since it opened at -8.5 (now -10.5) for the Players Era Festival game.

401921658.summary: Still no injury or news for either team at tip; the market backs unbeaten Oregon State (6-0) by 5.5 (opened 7.5, moving our way) at a neutral site in Palm Desert while most of our sources make it a near pick'em.

reasons.text: Oregon State enters 6-0; Tulsa is 4-1 after a 72-61 loss to Mississippi State on Nov 20. Neutral site (Acrisure Series); no injuries listed for either team.
Oregon State's own preview of the Palm Springs trip lists no injuries; still no injury news for Tulsa on game day.

swings.Nevada: Nevada's last game was a 91-74 home win over Idaho on Nov 19 (Elijah Price 21 pts); our ratings rose on the Wolf Pack more than the market did. No injury news (Nevada Athletics).

swings.Northern Kentucky: Nothing found: the market moved on Northern Kentucky without a clear reason (no injuries reported; opened -2.5, now -3.5).
swings.Georgia Southern: Nothing found: the market moved on Georgia Southern without a clear reason (no injuries listed on Covers, 11/23).

401921029.summary: Every source we use has Northern Kentucky by 5-6+, the market by 2.5 (unchanged from the open); no injury or lineup news found for either team.

reasons.text: Covers' game page lists no injuries for Georgia Southern or Northern Kentucky for the 7 PM ET game on 11/23.

swings.Akron: Nothing found on Akron; the opponent changed: Wright State is unbeaten (5-0) but plays without Dominic Pangonis and Noah Lewis (WHIO).

swings.Yale: Nothing found: the market moved on Yale without a clear reason (no injuries listed; last result a 76-74 OT win over Vermont on Nov 18).

swings.Monmouth: Nothing found on Monmouth (no injuries reported); the move is mostly UNC: PG Neo Avdalas is out about two months after Nov 16 wrist surgery (UNC), which the market weighs more than our ratings.

401913102.summary: Losing PG Neo Avdalas (wrist, out ~2 months) explains some of the gap, but newly eligible 7-footer Cameron Fens cuts the other way, so most of our 4.7-point edge on UNC is unexplained.

reasons.text: Starting guard Neo Avdalas (team-high 15 assists) broke his left wrist vs Georgia Nov 13, had surgery Nov 16 and is out about two months.
C Cameron Fens, who missed the first four games, is eligible under a temporary restraining order (through a hearing or Dec 1) and debuted vs Marshall; ratings mostly built without him.
No injuries reported for Monmouth (1-4); the line drifted from UNC -20.5 to -18.5 without a clear news reason.

returning.text: Eligible by court order after missing the first four games.

swings.San Diego State: Nothing found: no injury news for the unbeaten Aztecs (Nick Anderson's season-long knee injury is old news); the market has moved 2 pts away from them since the 7.5 opener for this Players Era neutral-site game.
swings.Iowa State: Nothing found: the market moved on Iowa State without a clear reason; no injury news, and the line went from -7.5 at open to -9.5 (DraftKings).

401909775.summary: Unexplained: no injury news for either team before tip (ESPN's game page lists none; Iowa State's Wiggins and Toure have been out all season), yet the line moved from Iowa State -7.5 at open to -9.5 (DraftKings).

reasons.text: Iowa State's only absences are season-long (Wiggins, Achilles; Toure, shoulder, back in January), already in our ratings; the regular rotation played on 11/15.
Previews from 11/22-11/23 list no availability news for either team; Iowa State has not played since 11/15.
Pre-game check 11/24: ESPN's game page lists no injuries for either team; DraftKings Iowa State -9.5.

swings.Temple: Likely guard Jordan Marsh: he missed the 11/22 SFA loss with an upper-body (wrist) injury and is day to day, and the line slid from Temple -4.5 to -2.5.

reasons.text: Temple guard Jordan Marsh (18-30 mpg) missed the 11/22 loss to Stephen F. Austin with an upper-body injury and is day to day for UT Martin.

swings.Utah Valley: Nothing found: the market moved on Utah Valley without a clear reason; no injury news found, and the line rose from Utah Valley -3.5 at open to -4.5.

401915942.summary: Our AlphaPoint model drives the gap (Texas Tech by 8.4; Haslametrics 4.5, v2 2.4); the market has moved from Tech -5.5 to -2.5 as Louisville confirmed Seth Trimble will play.

reasons.text: Pat Kelsey says Seth Trimble will play after missing the Stetson win; Isaac Ellis (ankle) is out all week, and De'Shayne Montgomery and Gabe Dynes remain out.
Texas Tech's JT Toppin (torn ACL, February) is still out; a return around the start of Big 12 play is more likely, per Grant McCasland. Neutral site in Las Vegas.

returning.text: Confirmed to play by Pat Kelsey after missing the Stetson win.

swings.Louisville: Louisville moved from 3 pts below the market to 4.3 above: Seth Trimble sat its last game (vs Stetson) and returns now, which the market may price differently; no other news found (Courier-Journal, 11/23).
swings.Texas Tech: No new Texas Tech news (JT Toppin is still out); the line moved from Tech -5.5 to -2.5 as Louisville said Seth Trimble will be back from a minor injury (CBS Sports, 11/23).

401906853.summary: Part of it: Tennessee's Jalen Haralson (knee) is now expected to sit out this neutral-site game, and the line has come down from Tennessee -5.5 to -3.5/-4.5; we found nothing else.

reasons.text: Jalen Haralson (20.5 mpg) hyperextended his right knee on 11/17 and missed Coastal Carolina on 11/21; game-day reports on 11/24 say he is expected to sit against Maryland.
The line opened Tennessee -5.5 and has moved toward Maryland (-3.5 in our feed, -4.5 at DraftKings); no injury news found for Maryland.

swings.Maryland Eastern Shore: Nothing found beyond results: no injury news; UMES lost 81-61 to IU Indy at a neutral site on 11/22 and was 0-5 in true road games going into this one, and the market has moved further against them than we have.

401917904.summary: No injury or lineup news found for either team; Tennessee Tech's results vs D1 teams and West Georgia's 0-4 start vs D1 back a big spread, but nothing explains the market going 5 points past our number.

reasons.text: West Georgia is 0-4 vs Division I (lost by 17 at DePaul, 23 at Loyola Chicago, 3 vs UNC Asheville, 24 at Charleston Southern); its two wins came vs non-D1 Columbia (SC) and Paine.
Tennessee Tech won 98-77 at UNC Asheville on 11/18, the same team that won 73-70 at West Georgia on 11/12; our ratings already count both results.
No injuries listed for either team on Covers' college basketball injury report (11/23).

swings.Campbell: Campbell won 80-70 at Kansas State on 11/21 (ESPN); our results-based ratings moved up on Campbell more than the market did. No injury news found.
swings.Coastal Carolina: Coastal's previous gap came in a 78-51 loss at No. 14 Tennessee on 11/21 (ESPN); no injury news in Coastal's 11/23 game preview, so the change mostly reflects Campbell's win at Kansas State.

swings.Furman: Nothing found: the market moved on Furman without a clear reason; no injuries reported (Covers, 11/23), and Furman's last game was a 108-69 win over non-D1 Clinton on 11/21.

swings.UC Santa Barbara: UNC Greensboro lost 89-62 at Pepperdine on Nov 23 and plays at UCSB the next night, a road back-to-back on a West Coast trip that the market prices more than our ratings do (ESPN schedule).

swings.Oregon State: Nothing found: no injury news on Oregon State. In its last game we were 5 pts lower on it than the market, and now we're level. Our ratings caught up after it beat Oregon 82-71 (Nov 20) and Tulsa 69-66 on DeShawn Gory's game-winner (Nov 23, ESPN recap: https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401921658).

swings.Tulsa: Nothing found: Tulsa had no injury news and played its usual rotation in the 69-66 loss to Oregon State (Nov 23, ESPN box score: https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401921658). Last game we were 5 pts higher on Tulsa than the market; now we're level, so the market moved on Tulsa without a clear reason.

swings.Stetson: Nothing found: the market moved on Stetson without a clear reason. There's no injury news, and Stetson used its usual rotation in the 83-69 loss at Louisville (Nov 19, ESPN: https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401918950). We have been higher on Stetson than the market in both logged games and are now 1.7 pts lower on it.

401918996.summary: No injury or lineup news for either team; South Florida's regular rotation all played its last game, and the line has dropped from USF -18.5 to -16.5 with no news behind the move.

reasons.text: South Florida is 3-3 with close losses to DePaul (82-80) and Saint Joseph's (83-80) and a 73-62 loss to George Mason; the market may weight that form more than we do.
Previews list no injuries for either side; Stetson is 1-5, line USF -18.5, total 152.5.

401909763.summary: Neutral-site game in Palm Desert; no injuries reported for either side, and the move from Stanford -2.5 to -4.5 looks like a reaction to Colorado's 77-74 home loss to Portland.

reasons.text: Colorado (2-3) lost 77-74 at home to Portland last Wednesday; Tad Boyle called it one of the two most disappointing losses of his 17 years.
Stanford (5-1) lists no injuries; Nick Townsend leads at 15.8 ppg and freshman Julius Price adds 14.2.

swings.Colorado: The market moved from Stanford -2.5 to -4.5 after Colorado's 77-74 home loss to Portland (Nov 19); no injuries found, and Colorado's regular rotation played that game (ESPN box score).
swings.Stanford: No news for either team: ESPN's DraftKings line is Stanford -4.5 at tip (opened -2.5), so the market did not turn against Stanford; the swing comes from this neutral-site line being read with the sides reversed (ESPN lists Stanford as the home side).

401921707.summary: No injury or lineup news found for either team before tip (Covers and ESPN list none); Wyoming's full rotation played its Sunshine Slam opener, and the line has moved from Wyoming -8.5 at open to -9.5, toward us.

reasons.text: Neutral site (Sunshine Slam, Ocean Center, Daytona Beach). Wyoming's top seven all played vs Duquesne on 11/22; the line has moved from the -8.5 opener to -9.5 (DraftKings).
Kent State freshman G Quinn Woidke (about 18 mpg early) has not played the last two games (ESPN box scores); no reason reported. That would lower Kent State, not raise it.
Pre-game check 11/24: Covers lists no injuries for Kent State, and ESPN's game page lists none for either team.

swings.Kent State: Nothing found: the market moved on Kent State without a clear reason; G Quinn Woidke has sat the last two games (ESPN box scores), which our ratings already include.
swings.Wyoming: Nothing found: no injury news on Wyoming. Our ratings rose after it beat Duquesne 79-61 (Nov 22); the market has moved only from -8.5 at open to -9.5.

swings.Oklahoma: F Duke Brennan (broken ankle in practice 11/16, starter, 8.3 ppg) is out long-term; the market priced it for the Campbell game and our ratings now carry a game without him (News 9, 11/16).

swings.Samford: Nothing found: the market moved on Samford without a clear reason; its regular rotation played in the 80-77 win over UNC Asheville on 11/22 (ESPN box score).

swings.DePaul: Nothing found: no injury news on DePaul (5-0, full rotation in its 83-39 win over UMES on Nov 18). The market moved from Purdue -4.5 to -2.5, with betting previews backing DePaul (Sports Gambling Podcast, Nov 24: https://www.sportsgamblingpodcast.com/2026/11/24/college-basketball-picks-for-november-24th-ncaa-basketball-banter-best-bets-ep-1257/).

swings.Wright State: Wright State lost 72-70 in OT to St. Bonaventure on Nov 24 with Dominic Pangonis and Noah Lewis out again and four starters playing 35-41 minutes; this is its third game in three days in Orlando, and the line slipped from -7.5 to -6.5 (ESPN box score, DraftKings).

swings.George Mason: Nothing found: no injury news, and George Mason's usual starters all played its 73-62 home win over South Florida on 11/21 (as a 3.5-pt favorite); the market moved up on the Patriots after that result.

401920528.summary: Nothing found to justify Maryland as a 1.5-pt favorite on a neutral Las Vegas floor; neither team has a confirmed key absence after both lost Tuesday.

reasons.text: Both lost on Nov. 24 in the Players Era: Maryland 72-64 to Tennessee and San Diego State 81-68 to Iowa State, so neither result moves the gap.
No confirmed injury for either team; one odds page lists Maryland guard Lukas Sotell as a game-time decision, unconfirmed elsewhere.

401920537.summary: Miami gets forward Malik Reneau back (he played 29 minutes vs TCU after missing two games), which covers some of the gap; Michigan has lost its last two, to Villanova and Creighton.

reasons.text: Malik Reneau (upper body), first-team All-ACC last season, missed the Rider and Manhattan games and returned for 29 minutes in the Nov. 24 loss to TCU.
Michigan lost 99-73 to Creighton on Nov. 24 after a 79-73 loss to Villanova; our ratings still have Michigan ahead of the market.

returning.text: Back from a two-game absence; played 29 minutes vs TCU on Nov. 24.

swings.Miami: Malik Reneau returned Nov. 24 vs TCU after missing two games; the market prices him in, while our ratings carry the games without him.

swings.Penn State: Nothing found: the market moved on Penn State without a clear reason (no injury news for either team before the Nov. 25 Battle 4 Atlantis game).

swings.Tennessee: Guard Jalen Haralson (right knee, hurt Nov. 17) missed Coastal Carolina and Maryland and is a game-time decision; the market likely leans on his return.

returning.text: Missed the last two games (knee); game-time decision vs Iowa State, re-evaluated Wednesday.

swings.Creighton: Creighton's 99-73 rout of Michigan on Nov. 24 lifted our ratings far more than the market; TCU forward Luke Bamgboye stays out (undisclosed).

401911028.summary: The market has marked Wisconsin down after two straight neutral-site losses and Jack Janicki's season-ending foot injury; Janicki is a bench guard, so that covers only part of our 5-point gap.

reasons.text: Guard Jack Janicki (17.8 mpg, 4.0 ppg) hurt his foot vs Murray State and is out for the season after surgery, Greg Gard said; Wisconsin is down to 12 available players.
Wisconsin lost both Baha Mar games, 74-69 to Seton Hall on 11/20 and 70-53 to Murray State on 11/21; the line opened Wisconsin -21.5 and has dropped to -19.5.
Guards Josh Manchester (shoulder) and LaTrevion Fenderson are also listed out, so Trey Autry and Jackson Ball absorb Janicki's minutes; both sat in the Murray State loss too.

swings.Wisconsin: The market dropped Wisconsin after the 74-69 Seton Hall and 70-53 Murray State losses (11/20-21) and Janicki's season-ending foot surgery (11/23); our rating moved less.
swings.Northeastern: Mirror of Wisconsin's move: the line fell from -21.5 to -19.5 on Wisconsin's losses and Janicki injury; Northeastern itself lost 84-77 to Butler and 95-82 at Stonehill.

swings.Louisville: Louisville beat Texas Tech 72-64 on 11/24 with Seth Trimble back (32 min), which lifted our rating toward the market; Texas Tech played without JT Toppin.

swings.Colorado: Colorado beat Stanford 70-65 as a 4.5-pt underdog on Nov 24 in the Acrisure Series at Acrisure Arena; this is its second game in two days. No injury news found (ESPN box score).

swings.Stanford: Stanford lost 70-65 to Colorado as a 4.5-pt favorite on Nov 24 at Acrisure Arena and plays again a day later; no injury news found, so the market moved on Stanford without a clear reason (ESPN box score).

401921672.summary: No injuries found for either team; the market has moved off Saint Louis (opened -4.5, now -3.5) after three straight losses, which our ratings already include.

reasons.text: Saint Louis has lost three straight: 68-58 at home to High Point (Nov 15), 95-78 to Saint Mary's (Nov 21) and 91-88 to Grand Canyon (Nov 24); the recap mentions no absences.
Both teams played Nov 24 in Palm Desert (Stanford lost 70-65 to Colorado), so neither has a rest edge; Quentin Jones, earlier hampered by an ankle, played 33 minutes Nov 24.

401921669.summary: The real market is LSU -4.5 (DraftKings via ESPN), almost exactly our LSU -4; the 'Arizona State -4.5' reading is a home/away flip, since ESPN lists Arizona State as the home team at neutral Acrisure Arena.

reasons.text: ESPN's game page lists Arizona State as home at Acrisure Arena (neutral site) with DraftKings' line LSU -4.5, so the 8.7-pt gap is a data mix-up, not a market view.
The line opened LSU -4.5 and the posted line is still LSU -4.5: no real move. No injuries listed for either team.

swings.LSU: Not a real swing: the market line was read with home and away flipped (real line LSU -4.5, ESPN game page); LSU is 6-0 and no injury news.
swings.Arizona State: Not a real swing: the market line was read with home and away flipped (real line LSU -4.5, ESPN game page); Arizona State is 5-0 and no injury news.
